descriptionHtml:
Job Description Summary

This role is responsible for supporting the identification, development, and evolution of product offerings for the business. Jobs at this level operate with some autonomy but are guided by well-defined commercial policies, product strategies, and review of end results. The role provides latitude to adapt procedures and practices, provided end results meet standards of acceptability, including quality, delivery, margin, customer satisfaction, and compliance requirements. This role impacts the quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of the associated product areas and has input into commercial and product priorities. It requires sound commercial judgment, technical depth, and cross-functional leadership to achieve desired outcomes. This role will work in close partnership with engineering, data science, domain, and business leaders to define and drive a clear strategic direction for an AI / Machine Learning advanced analytics software portfolio. This role will direct the team with a clear and descriptive set of requirements and deliver product features and functions by balancing customer need with business strategy, minimized defects, and technical debt. The role will ensure seamless integration and alignment of perspectives from a broad set of stakeholders including but not limited to: Customers, Process Owners, Enterprise Architects, Application Managers, UX, Development teams, and Technical Architects. This role will be responsible for the successful execution of Asset Performance Management analytics product offerings including SmartSignal and additional AI scope.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

In This Role You Will

  • Work with cross-functional teams to deliver features and significant products for power and energy resources software.

  • Own the short-term roadmap for MVPs and quarterly releases.

  • Prioritize continuously in accordance with the understanding and validation of customer problems and needs.

  • Engage frequently (70%) with the development team; facilitate discussions, provide clarification, story acceptance and refinement, testing and validation; contribute to design activities and decisions.

  • Own and manage the backlog; continuously order and prioritize to ensure that 1-2 sprints/iterations of backlog are always ready.

  • Collaborate with UX, ensuring that they are leading design decisions.

  • Work with product management leadership to understand customer and stakeholder personas and priorities.

  • Partner with the Service Owner to ensure healthy development process.

  • Be regarded as an expert in Agile Methodology; translate unstructured or ambiguous work requests into actionable user stories and work units.

  • Demonstrate superior persuasion and influencing skills that ensure alignment between customer, product manager, UX, and engineering teams.

  • Demonstrate business acumen, know latest industry trends, and be considered an internal functional expert on the product as well as the associated competitive landscape.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or “STEM” Majors (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math).

  • A minimum 8 years of professional experience working with software products involving AI, analytics, and/or data-driven applications.

  • Experience working in Agile software development environments with cross-functional engineering teams, including a working knowledge of backlog management, sprint planning, refinement, release planning, and execution.

Desired Characteristics

  • Strong oral and written communication skills, strong interpersonal and leadership skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems; document, plan, market, and execute programs.

  • Experience with Product Lifecycle Management programs in the development, go-to-market, and end-of-life phases.

  • Strong understanding of AI / ML product concepts, including predictive models, model performance metrics, data dependencies, monitoring, drift, explainability, and user adoption considerations.

  • Familiarity with GenAI concepts and applications such as copilots, summarization, retrieval-augmented generation, natural language interfaces, and intelligent workflow assistance.

  • Curiosity and practical awareness of emerging agentic AI patterns, including orchestration, tool use, autonomous task completion, and human oversight considerations.

  • Ability to identify customer business needs, strategic priorities, and opportunities for value delivery through voice-of-customer activities and product discovery.

  • Ability to adopt a holistic systems perspective, empathizing with multiple points of view, challenges program/product planning assumptions as appropriate.

  • Basic understanding of modern software architecture, including web applications, APIs, data pipelines, cloud platforms, and service-based architecture.

  • Experience developing or managing complex products using multiple services, databases and application server.

  • Experience troubleshooting customer-reported issues and partnering with technical teams to drive resolution.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Aha!, Azure DevOps, Splunk, Confluence, or similar platforms.

  • Strong business acumen and awareness of competitive and industry technology trends in AI and analytics software.

Special Skils Required

  • Demonstrated experience partnering with software engineering, data science, and domain teams to deliver complex technical products from concept through release.

Strong technical aptitude and demonstrated curiosity regarding emerging AI technologies and their practical application to customer challenges and product strategy

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

We help the world run better

At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

We are looking for a product management professional who can operate in this new paradigm — where AI is foundational to how products are discovered, built, and delivered.

As a Senior Product Specialist (Product Manager) for SAP Concur Spend, you will play a key role in shaping an AI-powered expense platform. You will work at the intersection of customer insight, product strategy, and intelligent automation, translating real-world problems into scalable, high-impact product capabilities.

You will independently lead product discovery, validate ideas through rapid prototyping, and drive execution in close partnership with engineering, design, and cross-functional stakeholders.

What You Build

Define and evolve the product roadmap aligned to customer needs, business priorities, and emerging AI-driven opportunities.Identify areas where AI can simplify workflows, automate decisions, and enhance user experience.

Design and deliver AI-powered capabilities, including Generative AI, copilots, and intelligent automation within SAP Concur Expense.Partner with engineering and data teams to integrate AI into enterprise-grade solutions.Ensure quality, reliability, and explainability of AI-driven outputs through continuous validation and iteration.

Lead discovery through rapid, AI-assisted prototyping and direct customer validation.Translate customer insights into intuitive, high-impact product experiences.Use data, experimentation, and usage insights to inform prioritization and product decisions.

Own the full product lifecycle from ideation to launch and post-release optimization. Drive backlog prioritization and execution alignment with engineering teams to ensure timely, high-quality delivery.

Lead product launches, including go-live readiness and customer transition planning.

Work closely with design, engineering, and field teams to ensure alignment across product development and delivery.

Manage dependencies and contribute to broader portfolio planning and execution.

Apply Agile and DevOps principles to improve delivery efficiency and product quality. Leverage AI-assisted development and analytics to accelerate iteration cycles and continuously enhance product outcomes.

What You Bring

Strong product management experience with ownership of roadmap, discovery, and delivery.

Ability to independently define problems, drive structured thinking, and execute with minimal oversight.

Practical exposure to Generative AI, automation, or AI-assisted product development, with an understanding of how to apply these to real customer problems.

Experience in data-driven decision-making, experimentation, and customer validation.

Strong customer engagement skills with the ability to translate insights into product direction.

Familiarity with expense management, finance systems, or enterprise SaaS is a plus.

Awareness of global product considerations, including localization and compliance.

Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to influence across cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with SAP Concur or broader spend management solutions

Exposure to AI/ML-powered enterprise product development

Strong Agile product management experience

Background in ERP, finance systems, or global product implementations

Where you Belong

At SAP Concur Spend, you will be part of a global, collaborative team building the next generation of AI-powered enterprise software. You will have the opportunity to shape intelligent, user-centric experiences that drive real customer impact at scale. SAP Concur Spend (Expense) Product Management is focused on reimagining expense management for an AI-first world. We are building intelligent, adaptive solutions that reduce manual effort, improve compliance, and proactively guide users toward better spend decisions.

By embedding Business AI, Generative AI, and agentic capabilities into the core of our platform, we are evolving from transactional workflows to self-optimizing, insight-driven experiences. Our goal is to deliver scalable, globally compliant solutions that continuously learn and improve with usage.

Bring out your best

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

We win with inclusion

SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.

For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements.

Successful candidates might be required to undergo a background verification with an external vendor.

AI Usage in the Recruitment Process

For information on the responsible use of AI in our recruitment process, please refer to our Guidelines for Ethical Usage of AI in the Recruiting Process.

Please note that any violation of these guidelines may result in disqualification from the hiring process.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
  • 3 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience designing and implementing automated evals, with new products with limited users and datasets.
  • Experience building and expanding the productivity software (e.g. Google Workspace), with an understanding of market drivers and user needs.
  • Experience in expanding the AI technologies and APIs along with knowledge in AI/ML.
  • Experience managing product road maps and executing complex launches.
  • Understanding of search technologies, ranking algorithms, indexing, and search and engagement metrics, how to apply them to guide product development.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate direction, influence stakeholders at all levels, and navigate complex organizational landscapes.

About The Job

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

As a Product Manager in Workspace Search, you will own the direction, strategy, and execution for critical Search products for billions of users. You will build new search offerings to improve search quality for human users and expand the Search for agentic users, enabling them to retrieve and utilize Workspace data. You will drive significant impact and shape the search experience for billions of Workspace users globally. You will work at the intersection of Search and AI, defining how intelligent systems convert information to action for users and collaborate with technology to solve challenging problems.

If you are passionate about Search and eager to build the future of information retrieval in the age of AI, we would love to hear from you!

AI will change the future of work in profound ways, and our products— Gmail, Docs, Drive, Calendar, Sheets, Vids and Meet are at the forefront. From pre-computed summaries for email threads, summaries for meetings, and videos created from a document using lifelike AI avatars, our AI opportunity is huge. Our mission is to meaningfully connect people so they can create, build, and grow together and as part of the team you can build how productivity tools should work 5-10 years into the future. You will work with model builders (Google DeepMind), work with exceptional leaders, and have the ability to impact billions of users across the world.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the product lifecycle for search within Workspace apps. Identify opportunities and deliver features to improve search quality and enhance the user experience across existing and emerging surfaces, including Generative AI features.
  • Develop and launch the API offering to provide agents with effective access to Workspace search results, unlocking new use cases and integrations.
  • Institute the processes for experimentation, evaluation, and iteration on search quality, leveraging user feedback, data analysis, and A/B testing. Drive the strategy and implementation of automated evaluation frameworks, particularly for novel search scenarios and greenfield projects, to ensure consistent quality and velocity.
  • Define and track key search success metrics to inform product decisions, measure impact, and communicate progress. Collaborate and influence a wide range of cross-functional teams, including Engineering, UX, Research, Marketing, and Leadership, to build consensus and drive execution.


Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

Introduction

Overview:

SymphonyAI is at the forefront of innovation, leveraging cutting-edge artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies to transform industries and drive business growth. As a global leader in AI-powered solutions, we empower organizations to harness the full potential of data-driven insights. SymphonyAI enterprise applications rapidly deliver transformative business value across retail, CPG, financial services, manufacturing, media, Enterprise IT (SymphonyAI Summit) and the public sector. SymphonyAI combines unrivalled AI technology, vertical expertise, and industry-specific data and insights into applications that drive the highest value for customers. We are one of the largest and fastest growing AI portfolios. We are on a mission to build a “World Class Engineering Team” with a high-performance culture.

Job Description

About the Role

SymphonyAI Industrial is seeking a Product Manager with 6-8 years of experience to help drive the roadmap and execution for the IRIS Foundry platform. This role focuses on building and enhancing industrial AI and data platform capabilities that enable predictive maintenance, reliability, operational intelligence, and industrial analytics solutions across manufacturing, energy, utilities, mining, and process industries.

The ideal candidate should have strong product management fundamentals, experience working with enterprise SaaS or platform products, and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, UX, data science, and customer-facing teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the product vision and roadmap for the IRIS Foundry platform.
  • Work with senior product leaders, customers, and engineering teams to identify and prioritize platform capabilities.
  • Support roadmap planning and release prioritization based on business impact and customer value.
  • Define detailed product requirements, user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria.
  • Partner with engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release planning.
  • Track feature delivery, dependencies, risks, and product quality metrics.
  • Collaborate with architects and engineers to ensure scalable and user-centric platform design.
  • Work closely with Engineering, UX/UI, Data Science, Customer engagement and professional services teams to ensure successful feature delivery and customer adoption.

Required Skills

  • Proven expertise as Product manager, ideally in managing enterprise SaaS or platform products.
  • Strong understanding of Agile product development methodologies.
  • Ability to write clear product requirements and user stories.
  • Good prioritization, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Understanding of Cloud-based platforms, APIs and integrations, Data platforms and analytics, AI/ML-driven applications, Enterprise software architecture
  • Exposure to industrial domain related AI applications such as below is desirable:
    • Asset Performance Management (APM)
    • Manufacturing operations
    • Industrial IoT
    • Reliability and maintenance systems
    • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
    • Ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination capabilities.
    • Customer-focused mindset with strong attention to detail.

    Qualifications

    • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
    • 6-8 years of product management experience in enterprise software, SaaS platforms, industrial technology, or AI-driven products.
    • Experience working with Agile/Scrum teams in fast-paced product organizations.
    • Prior experience in industrial software, manufacturing technology, or IoT platforms is preferred.

Description

Want to transform the way people interact with Alexa leveraging generative AI? Come join the team that is building the next-generation AI-assistant that gets things done across Timers, Alarms, Reminders, Calendars, Recipes, and News on Alexa devices. In this role, you'll drive product strategy and initiatives for a dedicated area within our Alexa Productivity Essentials team focused on driving engaging, high-traffic productivity scenarios for millions of customers worldwide. You’ll work with CX, science and engineering partners to build our next phase in making Alexa the world’s best personal assistant. The role presents an enormous opportunity to impact the customer experience for products that are used every day by people you know. We are looking for someone who is passionate about innovating on behalf of customers, has demonstrated product leadership skills, and thrives in an environment where they collaborate closely with colleagues across product, design, research, science and engineering.

Key job responsibilities

  • Drive the architectural and platform vision for the product space
  • Own the roadmap and translate customer requirement into technical specifications
  • Collaborate closely with developers and engineering managers to drive and prioritize the roadmaps and make technical decisions and tradeoffs connected to your product space
  • Recognize and scope new customer opportunities, translating customer needs into business and system requirements
  • Drive project schedules from design to launch
  • Make the right trade-offs to optimize time-to-market
  • Clearly communicate goals, metrics, roles, and responsibilities to internal and external stakeholders
  • Work with senior leaders within Alexa and throughout Amazon

A day in the life

You will own part of the Alexa Productivity Essentials initiative, defining the vision, strategy, product and tech roadmap across experiences loved and used by millions of customers. You will work closely with science, design, research and engineering partners to craft experiences to help customers more seamlessly get more done, and translate that vision into a product roadmap. You will also partner with product teams across Alexa to define how our experiences leverage new innovations in generative AI to help customers accomplish their goals. This is a “Think Big” role where you get to craft the vision and strategy for how customers experience our features across a range of Alexa touch-points.

About The Team

We’re a collaborative team that works closely together, fostering a creative and fun dynamic. We build Alexa experiences that customers connect with on a daily basis, connecting to the essential services that become part of their daily rhythm. The ideal candidate for this role will possess a strong product background with a penchant for cross-team collaboration across business, technical, and design counterparts. They will have deep technical skills and customer centric mindset with a history of launching notable products.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
  • Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
  • Experience with end to end product delivery
  • Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
  • Experience managing technical products or online services
  • Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
  • Master's degree in a technical field, or Master of Business Administration
  • Experience working directly with engineering teams
  • Experience influencing multiple stakeholders and leading cross functional teams across geographies and business units
  • Previous experience building products that leverage A.I., Machine Learning, Speech/Natural Language Understanding

About Nightfall:

Nightfall is the AI-native, unified data loss prevention and insider risk management platform that protects sensitive data across SaaS apps, GenAI tools, email, endpoint devices, and more. Hundreds of customers, spanning AI innovators to top 10 banks, trust Nightfall to detect and stop data exfiltration at scale. Nightfall enables organizations to innovate freely without the risks of losing intellectual property or exposing customer data. Our agentic platform helps security teams regain their time by putting data loss prevention on autopilot. With automatic remediation, security violations can be resolved automatically before they become incidents, and end-users can be automatically trained and coached in the moment to self-heal violations that they introduce.

Nightfall is backed by leading VC firms including Bain Capital Ventures (Enrique Salem - former CEO of Symantec), Venrock (early investors in Cloudflare), WestBridge Capital, Pear VC (early investors in Dropbox and Doordash), and a cadre of cybersecurity leaders including Frederic Kerrest (founder of Okta), Maynard Webb (former COO of eBay), Ryan Carlson (President of Chainguard), Kevin Mandia (founder of Mandiant), and many others.

About the role:

As a Senior Product Manager at Nightfall you'll lead the development and evolution of our data security product with coverage across SaaS, AI apps, endpoints and all major browser platforms. You'll develop a deep understanding of how organizations secure data and identify critical gaps in their data loss prevention approach especially with the evolving usage of AI apps.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ship AI security features fast - building MVPs, gathering feedback, and iterating based on real-world usage
  • Define success metrics: agent deployment rates, detection accuracy, remediation rates, exfiltration prevention metrics, system performance to avoid user friction and more
  • Work directly with engineering on sprint planning, backlog prioritization to achieve predictable release timelines
  • Build competitive differentiation by understanding what competitive vendors do poorly or have lack of coverage with endpoints, AI apps and agentic workflows
  • Document technical capabilities clearly for sales engineering, support, and customers - from architecture diagrams to deployment guides
  • Work with Sales Engineering and Customer Success during proof of value, customer deployments to ensure successful evaluation and adoption
  • Be comfortable presenting the product capabilities and differentiators to CISOs, SecOps teams across customer segments

What you need

Customer-Facing and Collaborative

  • 4 to 6 years of product management experience at a SaaS startup with a highly technical product.
  • Comfortable joining customer calls, demos, and technical discussions - you can speak credibly about how the product works, handle deployment issues, or
  • Experience working closely with sales engineering and customer success - you understand their workflows and help them win deals and secure renewals
  • Strong communication skills and an ability to translate technical requirements from security teams into clear product specifications

Execution-Oriented and Scrappy

  • Bias for action - you ship fast, iterate based on feedback, and don't wait for perfection
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change - you're building a category-defining product in a startup environment
  • Strong prioritization skills - you know what moves the needle vs what can wait
  • Entrepreneurial mindset - you'll do whatever it takes to make customers successful, from troubleshooting agent issues to writing KB articles
  • Hard-working and resilient - this is a high-intensity role that requires deep focus and relentless execution

Bonus Points

  • Prior experience as a founder, security engineer or product manager on an endpoint product or similar hands-on security role
  • Understanding of MDM platforms, strong grasp of endpoint DLP and browser extension architecture, security frameworks and limitations across macOS, Windows
  • Knowledge of compliance frameworks, AI apps and agentic workflows and how they drive DLP requirements
  • Experience with ML/AI-based detection and classification systems
  • Background in SaaS security products and understanding of cloud-to-endpoint integration patterns
  • Graduated with a Computer Science (or similar) degree

Environment

Nightfall AI takes pride in being an equal-opportunity employer. We value a diverse and global talent pool and the collaboration that results from having a diverse and inclusive team. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Our hiring decisions are based exclusively on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

Compensation

Employee compensation will be determined based on interview performance, level of experience, specialization of skills, and market rate. During the offer discussion, your recruiter will review the finalized base salary, bonus (for applicable roles), benefits & perks, and stock options as they’ll be reflected in the offer letter.

About Us
QuillBot was founded in 2017 with a mission to help students and professionals strengthen their writing. Today, we help over 56 million people around the world create great things. Whether you're writing, designing, coding, or collaborating, QuillBot is a place where anyone can create at the speed of thought. Our AI-powered tools help you think clearly, communicate effectively, and create beautifully—across every platform, in any format, at any skill level. If you're passionate about using technology to make the path from inspiration to execution more accessible, intentional, and relevant, come join us.

Role Overview
Now we’re building a full AI-powered creation platform that supports them from the first spark of an idea to a finished, shareable piece of work.

The creation suite is a key pillar of this evolution, the space where users can transform their words into visually compelling assets: presentations, campaigns, PDFs, social posts, and more.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead this effort and shape the future of how people create with QuillBot.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the evolution of the creation suite from MVP to a flagship QuillBot product—driving the roadmap, success metrics, and user experience.
  • Own the end-to-end user journey for visual creation—from ideation to layout to export.
  • Partner with engineers, designers, marketing, brand, SEO and researchers to turn text and ideas into adaptive, multimodal outputs.
  • Define and validate workflows, templates, and design systems that make non-designers feel like creators.
  • Collaborate closely with the Writing and Chat product teams to ensure seamless handoffs between idea, draft, and design.
  • Use data, research, and product intuition to balance user delight, technical feasibility, and business impact.
  • Lead a cross-functional pod toward measurable outcomes—traffic, engagement, retention, and satisfaction.

Qualification 

  • 6+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years building/growing creation or design-centric products.
  • A track record of taking consumer-facing tools from 0→1 or 1→N, ideally with products in the creative or productivity space.
  • Experience in AI-assisted or automation-heavy workflows—text-to-image, auto-layout, or generative creation—is highly desirable.
  • Deep understanding of UX for creative tools and empathy for non-technical users.
  • Strong design sensibility—you understand layout, visual hierarchy, and what makes creation feel effortless.
  • Data-driven mindset; comfort working with analytics to inform decisions and measure success.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across design, engineering, marketing, and leadership.

What You Can Expect to Do in Your 180 Days

First 30 Days: Learn & Align

  • Deep-dive into QuillBot’s creation platform vision, user personas, and current MVP.
  • Understand the existing creation suite experience, performance metrics, and user pain points.
  • Conduct a competitive benchmarking.
  • Build strong partnerships with Design, Engineering, and AI/UX Research leads.
  • Align on near-term success metrics and team priorities.

30-90 Days: Define & Prioritize

  • Craft a clear roadmap for post-MVP development—defining which workflows, templates, and features matter most.
  • Lead early experiments in user experience, template expansion, and AI-assisted creation.
  • Establish analytics and feedback loops for measuring product success.
  • Partner with marketing and growth to position the creation suite within QuillBot’s ecosystem.

90–180 Days—Execute & Scale

  • Launch new workflows or features that significantly improve user creation speed and output quality.
  • Define and validate the long-term strategy for multimodal, brand-aware creation.
  • Drive engagement growth and user retention through data-backed iteration.
  • Build the foundation for QuillBot’s primary visual creation surface.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Own one of the most impactful growth and experimentation surfaces at QuillBot.
  • Shape how millions of users discover and first experience QuillBot.
  • Work at the intersection of AI, growth, and product systems.
  • Collaborate with a team that values speed, learning, and thoughtful product decisions.
  • Be a key driver of QuillBot’s transition from individual tools to a cohesive creation platform.

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive salary and annual bonus
  • Medical coverage
  • Life and accidental insurance
  • Vacation & leaves of absence (menstrual, flexible, special, and more!)
  • Developmental opportunities through education & developmental reimbursements & professional workshops
  • Maternity & parental leave
  • Hybrid & remote model with flexible working hours
  • On-site & remote company events throughout the year
  • Tech & WFH stipends & new hire allowances
  • Employee referral program
  • Premium access to QuillBot

*Benefits and benefit amounts differ by region. A comprehensive list applicable to your region will be provided in your interview process.

Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds often don't apply for roles if they don't meet all the criteria. We strongly encourage you to apply if you're interested: we'd love to learn how you can amplify our team with your unique experience!

This role is eligible for hire in India.

We are a virtual-first company with employees across the United States, Canada, India, Germany, and the Netherlands. Our compensation approach is market-based and varies by location while ensuring fairness, consistency, and transparency.

The base pay for this role is determined by several factors, including:

  • Relevant professional experience
  • Skills and expertise
  • Scope and responsibilities of the role
  • Internal equity considerations 

In addition to base salary, total compensation may include bonus, equity, and benefits. Eligibility depends on role, level, and location.

We are committed to equal pay for equal work, and all compensation decisions are made using consistent, gender-neutral criteria in alignment with pay transparency requirements

Role Summary

Job Description – Oracle Product Hub Architect (with EDMCS Expertise)

The Oracle Product Hub Architect will lead the enterprise Product Master strategy using Oracle Product Hub (OPH), ensuring seamless integration with EDMCS (Enterprise Data Management Cloud Service) and RMCS (Revenue Management Cloud Service).

This role requires a techno‑functional blend of architecture design, data modelling, integration expertise, and deep understanding of product, pricing, and revenue data flows.

You will work multi-functionally with Product, Finance, Billing, Pricing, Data Governance, Architecture, and Technology teams to establish a unified, governed, accurate, and scalable product data foundation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oracle Product Hub Architecture
  • Lead the design and governance of the enterprise Product Master in Oracle Product Hub.
  • Define product structures, item classes, attributes, catalogs, lifecycle rules, validations, and workflows.
  • Develop scalable patterns for product creation, enrichment, approval, and publishing processes.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise data governance, MDM strategy, and architecture principles.
  • Integration with EDMCS
  • Architect end‑to‑end integrations between OPH and EDMCS for:
  • Product hierarchies
  • Dimension mappings
  • Attribute synchronization
  • Governance workflows
  • Define patterns using APIs, OIC/ODI, file-based (FBDI), or event-driven integrations.
  • Govern metadata, lineage, and mapping logic to ensure consistency with Planning, Reporting, and ERP.
  • Integration with RMCS
  • Design OPH → RMCS integration for:
  • Product catalog synchronization
  • Pricing attributes
  • Revenue recognition attributes
  • Contract and billing dependencies
  • Ensure product attributes required for revenue allocation, SSP rules, POB setup, and accounting treatments flow accurately into RMCS.
  • Coordinate reconciliation mechanisms to ensure RMCS reflects the correct product and revenue metadata.
  • Data Flow & Process Architecture
  • Map end‑to‑end product, pricing, and revenue data flows across:
  • OPH → EDMCS
  • OPH → RMCS
  • OPH → ERP (Oracle Cloud/SAP)
  • OPH → Billing systems
  • OPH → CRM (Salesforce, Dynamics, etc.)
  • OPH → Data Warehouse / Data Lake
  • OPH → Finance & Regulatory reporting
  • Identify upstream/downstream impacts, dependencies, and integration risks.
  • Define data lineage, quality rules, enrichment logic, and reconciliation frameworks.
  • Techno‑Functional Leadership
  • Translate functional requirements from Finance, Pricing, and Product teams into technical architecture.
  • Define governance models for product setup, change management, and attribute ownership.
  • Participate in workshops, design sessions, sprint planning, and UAT.
  • Provide thought leadership on Product Master standards across global teams.
  • Integration & Architectural Governance
  • Lead integration patterns across OPH, EDMCS, RMCS, ERP, and Billing.
  • Define API contracts, mapping documents, transformation logic, error handling, and exception flows.
  • Guide development teams and ensure alignment to architectural standards.
  • Drive consistent design patterns and reusable frameworks across regions and business units.
  • Quality, Controls & Compliance
  • Establish strong data quality, lineage, and validation controls across OPH and integrations.
  • Support audit and compliance requirements for Finance, Accounting, and Regulatory functions.
  • Ensure proper controls for product attribute changes and hierarchy modifications.
  • Production Support & Continuous Improvement
  • Provide L4 architectural guidance for production incidents and data integrity issues.
  • Conduct root‑cause analysis for data flow issues between OPH, EDMCS, RMCS, and downstream systems.
  • Collaborate with teams to optimize performance, reduce manual work, and enhance automation.

Technical Skills

Skills & Experience Required

  • Deep implementations of Oracle Product Hub (mandatory):
  • Item architecture
  • Catalogs & item classes
  • Lifecycle workflows
  • Product attribute governance
  • Import/Export (EGO, FBDI)
  • Strong hands-on with EDMCS:
  • Hierarchy management
  • Data governance
  • Mappings, validations, and approvals
  • Good understanding of RMCS (required):
  • Product catalog and revenue attributes
  • Revenue allocation methods and POB setup
  • Pricing and SSP-related attributes
  • Expertise with:
  • Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)
  • ODI / FBDI / REST APIs / SOAP APIs
  • SQL and data modelling
  • Event-driven architecture (Kafka optional)
  • Experience integrating product data with ERP (Oracle Cloud/SAP) and CRM/Billing systems.

Functional Skills

  • Good understanding of:
  • Product lifecycle & governance
  • Pricing and revenue recognition models
  • Product-to-accounting mappings
  • Planning/reporting hierarchy usage (EDMCS)
  • Good background in Finance processes, Billing, and Revenue Operations.
  • Experience in handling functional workshops with Finance, Product, and Business SMEs.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.
  • 12–15+ years in ERP/MDM/Data Architecture roles.
  • Shown experience with Oracle Product Hub, EDMCS, and RMCS integrations is important.
  • Experience in large, complex global organisations preferred.

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.

𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗱𝗲𝘁𝗮𝗶𝗹𝘀:

  • Working model: Hybrid
  • Start date: ASAP
  • Employment type: Full-time, Contract or Freelance


𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀:

  • Define a compelling multi-year product strategy and annual roadmaps for fleet management tools and driver-facing applications
  • Maintain a strong pulse on market trends, competitive landscape, and user behavior to inform prioritization
  • Balance long-term platform investments with short-term feature delivery, ensuring scalability and sustainability
  • Collaborate with regional teams to adapt solutions for local market needs, compliance requirements, and partner integrations
  • Partner with engineering and UX to deliver high-quality web and mobile experiences — writing clear requirements, prioritizing backlogs, and defining success metrics
  • Lead cross-functional execution across distributed teams and communicate roadmap, progress, and trade-offs to senior stakeholders

  • Use data and customer insights to continuously improve adoption and retention


𝗤𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗳𝗶𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; MBA preferred
  • 10+ years of product management experience with a strong background in B2B and/or platform products
  • Experience in automotive, EVs, logistics, or mobility ecosystems is a strong plus
  • Solid understanding of connected vehicle platforms, telematics, APIs, and mobile, web, and embedded (in-vehicle) architectures
  • Proven ability to define, deliver, and measure end-to-end customer experiences across digital and physical touchpoints
  • Strong grasp of software architecture and connected services, with confidence to make trade-offs and challenge assumptions alongside engineering partners
  • Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum practices including backlog ownership, iteration planning, and cross-functional delivery
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and build consensus

  • Press "Apply"
  • We will review your application
  • If qualified, you will be accepted into the network and can be considered for this and similar positions & projects

descriptionHtml:
About Learneo
Learneo is a platform of builder-driven businesses, including Course Hero, CliffsNotes, LitCharts, Quillbot, Symbolab, and Scribbr, all united around a shared mission of supercharging productivity and learning for everyone. We attract and scale high growth businesses built and run by visionary entrepreneurs. Each team innovates independently but has a unique opportunity to collaborate, experiment, and grow together, and they are supported by centralized corporate operations functions, including HR, Finance and Legal.

Role Overview
Now we’re building a full AI-powered creation platform that supports them from the first spark of an idea to a finished, shareable piece of work.

The creation suite is a key pillar of this evolution, the space where users can transform their words into visually compelling assets: presentations, campaigns, PDFs, social posts, and more.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead this effort and shape the future of how people create with Quillbot.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the evolution of the creation suite from MVP to a flagship Quillbot product—driving the roadmap, success metrics, and user experience.
  • Own the end-to-end user journey for visual creation—from ideation to layout to export.
  • Partner with engineers, designers, marketing, brand, SEO and researchers to turn text and ideas into adaptive, multimodal outputs.
  • Define and validate workflows, templates, and design systems that make non-designers feel like creators.
  • Collaborate closely with the Writing and Chat product teams to ensure seamless handoffs between idea, draft, and design.
  • Use data, research, and product intuition to balance user delight, technical feasibility, and business impact.
  • Lead a cross-functional pod toward measurable outcomes—traffic, engagement, retention, and satisfaction.

Qualification 

  • 6+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years building/growing creation or design-centric products.
  • A track record of taking consumer-facing tools from 0→1 or 1→N, ideally with products in the creative or productivity space.
  • Experience in AI-assisted or automation-heavy workflows—text-to-image, auto-layout, or generative creation—is highly desirable.
  • Deep understanding of UX for creative tools and empathy for non-technical users.
  • Strong design sensibility—you understand layout, visual hierarchy, and what makes creation feel effortless.
  • Data-driven mindset; comfort working with analytics to inform decisions and measure success.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across design, engineering, marketing, and leadership.

What You Can Expect to Do in Your 180 Days

First 30 Days: Learn & Align

  • Deep-dive into Quillbot’s creation platform vision, user personas, and current MVP.
  • Understand the existing creation suite experience, performance metrics, and user pain points.
  • Conduct a competitive benchmarking.
  • Build strong partnerships with Design, Engineering, and AI/UX Research leads.
  • Align on near-term success metrics and team priorities.

30-90 Days: Define & Prioritize

  • Craft a clear roadmap for post-MVP development—defining which workflows, templates, and features matter most.
  • Lead early experiments in user experience, template expansion, and AI-assisted creation.
  • Establish analytics and feedback loops for measuring product success.
  • Partner with marketing and growth to position the creation suite within Quillbot’s ecosystem.

90–180 Days—Execute & Scale

  • Launch new workflows or features that significantly improve user creation speed and output quality.
  • Define and validate the long-term strategy for multimodal, brand-aware creation.
  • Drive engagement growth and user retention through data-backed iteration.
  • Build the foundation for Quillbot’s primary visual creation surface.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Own one of the most impactful growth and experimentation surfaces at Quillbot.
  • Shape how millions of users discover and first experience Quillbot.
  • Work at the intersection of AI, growth, and product systems.
  • Collaborate with a team that values speed, learning, and thoughtful product decisions.
  • Be a key driver of Quillbot’s transition from individual tools to a cohesive creation platform.

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive salary and annual bonus
  • Medical coverage
  • Life and accidental insurance
  • Vacation & leaves of absence (menstrual, flexible, special, and more!)
  • Developmental opportunities through education & developmental reimbursements & professional workshops
  • Maternity & parental leave
  • Hybrid & remote model with flexible working hours
  • On-site & remote company events throughout the year
  • Tech & WFH stipends & new hire allowances
  • Employee referral program
  • Premium access to Quillbot

*Benefits and benefit amounts differ by region. A comprehensive list applicable to your region will be provided in your interview process.

Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds often don't apply for roles if they don't meet all the criteria. We strongly encourage you to apply if you're interested: we'd love to learn how you can amplify our team with your unique experience!

This role is eligible for hire in India.

We are a virtual-first company with employees across the United States, Canada, India, Germany, and the Netherlands. Our compensation approach is market-based and varies by location while ensuring fairness, consistency, and transparency.

The base pay for this role is determined by several factors, including:

  • Relevant professional experience
  • Skills and expertise
  • Scope and responsibilities of the role
  • Internal equity considerations 

In addition to base salary, total compensation may include bonus, equity, and benefits. Eligibility depends on role, level, and location.

We are committed to equal pay for equal work, and all compensation decisions are made using consistent, gender-neutral criteria in alignment with pay transparency requirements

Description

Want to transform the way people interact with Alexa leveraging generative AI? Come join the team that is building the next-generation AI-assistant that gets things done across Timers, Alarms, Reminders, Calendars, Recipes, and News on Alexa devices. In this role, you'll drive product strategy and initiatives for a dedicated area within our Alexa Productivity Essentials team focused on driving engaging, high-traffic productivity scenarios for millions of customers worldwide. You’ll work with CX, science and engineering partners to build our next phase in making Alexa the world’s best personal assistant. The role presents an enormous opportunity to impact the customer experience for products that are used every day by people you know. We are looking for someone who is passionate about innovating on behalf of customers, has demonstrated product leadership skills, and thrives in an environment where they collaborate closely with colleagues across product, design, research, science and engineering.

Key job responsibilities

  • Drive the architectural and platform vision for the product space
  • Own the roadmap and translate customer requirement into technical specifications
  • Collaborate closely with developers and engineering managers to drive and prioritize the roadmaps and make technical decisions and tradeoffs connected to your product space
  • Recognize and scope new customer opportunities, translating customer needs into business and system requirements
  • Drive project schedules from design to launch
  • Make the right trade-offs to optimize time-to-market
  • Clearly communicate goals, metrics, roles, and responsibilities to internal and external stakeholders
  • Work with senior leaders within Alexa and throughout Amazon

A day in the life

You will own part of the Alexa Productivity Essentials initiative, defining the vision, strategy, product and tech roadmap across experiences loved and used by millions of customers. You will work closely with science, design, research and engineering partners to craft experiences to help customers more seamlessly get more done, and translate that vision into a product roadmap. You will also partner with product teams across Alexa to define how our experiences leverage new innovations in generative AI to help customers accomplish their goals. This is a “Think Big” role where you get to craft the vision and strategy for how customers experience our features across a range of Alexa touch-points.

About The Team

We’re a collaborative team that works closely together, fostering a creative and fun dynamic. We build Alexa experiences that customers connect with on a daily basis, connecting to the essential services that become part of their daily rhythm. The ideal candidate for this role will possess a strong product background with a penchant for cross-team collaboration across business, technical, and design counterparts. They will have deep technical skills and customer centric mindset with a history of launching notable products.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
  • Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
  • Experience with end to end product delivery
  • Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
  • Experience managing technical products or online services
  • Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
  • Master's degree in a technical field, or Master of Business Administration
  • Experience working directly with engineering teams
  • Experience influencing multiple stakeholders and leading cross functional teams across geographies and business units
  • Previous experience building products that leverage A.I., Machine Learning, Speech/Natural Language Understanding

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. description: About ZscalerZscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate—we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession, collaboration, ownership, and accountability.We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate—we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession, collaboration, ownership, and accountability.

We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our team in a Hybrid capacity, reporting to the Director, Product Management within the Product Management department. You will drive the vision, strategy, and execution of the Zscaler DSPM product line at the forefront of the world’s cloud security leader. By joining our team of innovation champions, you will deliver a growing portfolio of capabilities in threat prevention, visibility, and business enablement while shaping the future product roadmap.

What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)

  • Lead the vision and lifecycle for specific modules within the Zscaler DSPM suite, ensuring the roadmap is agile and aligned with Zscaler’s high-level business priorities and market trends
  • Translate complex market needs into detailed technical requirements, providing clear needs to Engg teams to build high-performance features meeting acceptance criteria
  • Partner with other teams to navigate the development lifecycle, removing roadblocks and adjusting requirements for timely delivery
  • Act as the subject matter expert by analyzing the competitive landscape, identifying growth opportunities, and neutralizing threats through informed, data-driven product pivots
  • Drive product adoption by collaborating with Marketing and Sales on GTM plans and engaging with customers for roadmap presentations, feedback loops, and high-level escalations


Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.


What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Bridge the gap between technical and business audiences, communicating complex concepts to internal teams, executives, and customers
  • 3–5 years of dedicated experience in Enterprise Product Management, specifically within the Cybersecurity or Information Security domains
  • Proven experience with Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and data classification products with understanding of legacy tools and modern AI-based classification methods
  • Deep knowledge of Cloud Security products (commercial and CSP-native) and unique security challenges inherent to cloud environments
  • Hands-on experience and technical working knowledge of at least one major public cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)


What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Knowledge of Cloud Posture Security Management (CSPM), auto-remediation, activity analytics, cloud-native API’s, security frameworks and compliance standards
  • Technical degree or a background in hands-on engineering, providing the architectural depth needed to lead complex product modules
  • Prior success in roles such as Escalation Engineering, Sales Engineering, or Deployment Services

We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.

About The Team

This role will be part of Lowe’s Technology organization powering the Finance Technology Modernization program for Lowe’s Finance & Accounting. The vision of Finance Technology Modernization program is to deliver modern applications and tools that enable Lowe’s Finance & Accounting organization to rapidly operationalize strategic enterprise initiatives, drive productivity through automation/AI, and deploy modernized foundational capabilities for transaction processing, internal control and compliance, and financial reporting.

Job Summary

executing direction from leadership, delivering results that align with strategic objectives, communicating critical information to other teams, managing vendor relationships, developing processes that align to organizational goals, specific technical skills required for managing a process.

The Sr Product Manager owns the vision and strategy, roadmap, and feature definition for large, cross- functional and/or highly complex products. Responsibilities include defining the roadmap as well as planning and managing products and product features through the product development process. This role manages the product backlogs for a product group while prioritizing work and making product-related decisions based on the needs and expectations of customers and stakeholders. The individual in this role identifies and manages projects with a high level of autonomy. He/she manages multiple product designs at any given time while partnering closely with the business to understand pain points and develop the go-to-market strategy.

Roles & Responsibilities

Core Responsibilities:

Defines multiple large, cross-functional and/or highly complex products and identifies gaps and customer needs by creating vision, strategy and requirements documents for product(s); utilizing available studies (market research, internal) and competitive analysis to identify customer needs; performing experiments to uncover additional customer value; and partnering with the business to define product roadmaps and to establish the product vision

Develops and manages the product roadmap, demonstrating expertise at the product group level, building partnerships with relevant stakeholder teams, and making trade-off decisions for multiple products in a product group

Leads the product planning process across a product group by overseeing the development of requirements documents (user stories with acceptance criteria, use cases) for products or product releases; working closely with UX to oversee the design of the user experience across the product group; monitoring release goals, prioritization, implementation, and iteration plans for a product group; and resolving problems that are escalated

Leads the development process by reviewing demos with the technology team and validating acceptance criteria for all products in the product group; and reviewing the development work and resolving escalated issues and bugs at a product group level

Leads large, highly complex product launches by working with relevant stakeholders to develop launch and go-to-market plans, reviewing and resolving issues and blockers in partnership with team members that may delay the launch or impede the success of product(s)

Manages scaled launches, sometimes of multiple complex products, in collaboration with leadership

Tracks and reports on product launch metrics, utilizing feedback to drive associated actions and product iteration; contributes to post-launch reviews and drives incorporation of feedback in future product releases

Represents team in product group-level discussions with internal and external stakeholders; uses data analysis to address complex and ambiguous problems that often involve multiple stakeholder teams and span across products in a product group

Works with relevant internal and external stakeholders to identify and prioritize product group-level customer issues and customer experience gaps; uses findings to determine short and medium-term risk and opportunities for the product group and drive further customer adoption

Provides coaching and guidance to more junior level product management team members; Uses analytics to monitor product KPIs and ensure success metrics are being met; identifies opportunities for testing and product/product group enhancements based on results

Attends business reviews, providing critical input and expert insight into to inform the development of new products

Maintains a prioritized product backlog based on defined business value, aligning with Product Strategy and resource capacity; uses data and analytics to prioritize the product backlog appropriately

Reviews and approves large requirements (Epics) based on product strategy

Aligns efforts across product teams, prioritizing as necessary, and driving/facilitating execution to maintain focus and appropriate momentum

Builds and leverages solid working relationships with business and product stakeholders, other Product Managers, user experience and technology teams to facilitate successful product implementation

Provides UX/UI approval for assigned products

Provides direction to cross-functional teams, including engineering teams and business functions, communicating the product/product group roadmap and keeping everyone informed of updates

Years Of Experience

5 years of experience in two or more of the following: project management, product management, business analysis, program management or product marketing

3 years of experience in product and/or experience management

Required Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Communications, or related field (or equivalent work experience in a related field)

Preferred Qualifications / Good To Have

Master's Degree in Business Administration or similar advanced degree, with specialization in Finance and Accounting

Finance / Accounting professional certifications - CFA, FRM, CPA, Chartered Accountant, Cost Accountant, etc.

Experience collaborating closely with senior leadership

Experience providing guidance and direction to cross-functional resources

Continue Learning

Plan and Align

Lead Product Manager – AI-Native Development

Location: Bangalore / Chennai / Mumbai

Work Mode: Hybrid

Experience: 6–9 years (3–5 years in Product Management)

Employment Type: Full-time


Role Overview

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager – AI Native Development who combines product leadership with hands-on building capability.

This is not a traditional roadmap-driven PM role. We are hiring leaders who personally prototype, build, and ship AI-powered product flows using modern AI-assisted development environments such as Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar tools.

You will lead the development of AI-first products end-to-end, driving strategy, execution, and delivery at speed while mentoring teams and shaping product direction.

Experience

  • 6–9 years total experience
  • Minimum 6–12 months of hands-on AI-native product development (mandatory)
  • Proven ability to lead and ship AI-powered products at scale
  • Strong understanding of AI/ML product ecosystems and trends
  • Ability to balance strategy with execution (builder mindset)
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth environments
  • Demonstrated experience in leading product initiatives or teams
  • Strong mentorship and team-building capabilities
  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive decisions
  • Startup or product-led company experience
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini)
  • Background in engineering, design, or technical product management

descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Senior Product Manager

Experience: 6–10 years

Location: Bangalore – Work From Office (WFO)


About Aerchain (Why Us?)

We're rewriting the rules of procurement with an AI-first platform that powers $20B+ in enterprise spend. From $4M ARR today to $25M ARR and beyond, our mission is to build enterprise-grade, AI-first procurement software for global enterprises across manufacturing, FMCG, and services.


Role Snapshot

You'll own a cluster of modules and be accountable for the outcomes they drive across customers. You'll work with enterprise clients to ensure they realise value from the product, lead solutioning for complex accounts, define what the cluster builds and why, and ensure every module delivers measurable customer value. You'll work across business, engineering, and leadership — and develop the PMs and APMs in your cluster. You report to the Product Lead.


What You’ll Drive

Problem Discovery & Research

  • Drive discovery across the cluster — understand customer problems, workflows, and success criteria at the deepest level.
  • Set the standard for how problems are diagnosed and sized across your PMs. Challenge recommendations, not just review them.
  • Zero escalations without a fully formed recommendation and reasoning.


Customer Ownership

  • Own Tier A customer engagements end-to-end — from understanding their problems to ensuring they realise value from the product.
  • Solution enterprise clients independently, coordinating with PMs where modules overlap.
  • Be the single point of contact for Tier A customers — through delivery, adoption, and outcome validation.


Solutioning & Prototyping

  • Own the cluster roadmap — what gets built, deferred, and killed across all modules, with reasoning tied to customer outcomes.
  • Sign off on PRDs and prototypes from your PMs. Not as an approval gate — as the person who knows the modules well enough to find what's missing.
  • Use AI across every step — research, problem framing, drafting, prototyping, validation. Set the standard for the cluster.


Execution & Delivery

  • Oversee delivery across the cluster. Sign off on sprint plans and ensure PMs are unblocked and on track.
  • Own the quality bar across all modules. A delivery failure in the cluster is your failure.


Release & Adoption

  • Hold the customer-value metrics standard across all modules in the cluster. PMs define — you challenge and validate.
  • Own post-release outcomes for Tier A customers. Stay in the loop until value is confirmed.
  • Develop PMs and APMs in your cluster — build their judgment, not just their output.


You’ll thrive here if

  • 6–10 years in product roles with clear progression from feature ownership to module or product area ownership.
  • You diagnose complex, ambiguous problems and make high-stakes calls with confidence — not just for yourself, but to set the standard for your team.
  • You use AI as a core part of how you work and raise the bar for those around you.
  • You develop people by doing — you show PMs and APMs what good looks like, not just tell them.
  • You own outcomes, not activities. You stay in the loop until value is confirmed, not until the feature ships.
  • Bonus: exposure to enterprise SaaS, complex B2B environments, or procurement tech.


What’s In It For You

  • Cluster-level ownership with full authority over what gets built and why.
  • Work with enterprise clients on problems that matter — and stay accountable until value is confirmed.
  • A direct line to the Product Lead with no bureaucracy between your judgment and the decisions that matter.
  • A culture where problem solving, ownership, and action are rewarded — and the opposite is called out.


Ready to build Aerchain’s future?

If reimagining business engines with AI and solving problems at scale excites you, let's talk.

Apply now and help us build the most agile enterprise SaaS story in the world.

Description

RBS SPEG (Selling Partner Engagement and Growth) team is looking for a Sr Product Manager to drive the product roadmap for its key GenAI offering for VMs/AMs across Amazon Stores. In this role, you will partner with Amazon Retail and 3P teams WW to deeply understand user workflows, identify high-impact opportunity areas, and define the product strategy and roadmap for SAMAI - GenAI Copilot for VMs/AMs.

You will operate as the single-threaded owner for the product, driving end-to-end product development from concept to launch and scale. This includes leading 0→1 initiatives, defining intuitive and scalable user experiences, and building mechanisms to continuously capture and incorporate Voice of Customer (VoC).

Candidate Profile

The role requires strong product ownership in highly ambiguous problem spaces, the ability to navigate complex system and organizational dependencies, and sound judgment in prioritization and trade-offs. You will work closely with engineering and partner teams to deliver scalable, high-quality solutions, while independently driving alignment across stakeholders and influencing senior leadership through clear, data-driven thinking.

You will also be responsible for driving adoption across geographies, defining success metrics, and establishing mechanisms to inspect progress and ensure long-term business impact.

Key skills for the role include understanding of tech, ability to deal with ambiguity, to network effectively and influence partner teams without authority, to overcome unforeseen obstacles, and a passion for developing a deep understanding of the product and ops excellence.

Key job responsibilities

Key job responsibilities

Develop product roadmap for SAMAI, through user requirements gathering, and converting them into high fidelity product requirements

Define the User Experience, lead design workshops and build mechanisms to capture VoC

Design and lead roadmaps to drive product adoption across all Amazon MPs.

Define the P0 metrics for adoption, and mechanisms for VoC to ensure we partner with our engineering partners to make right trade-offs, and build synergies between tech and product teams.

Be responsible for communicating our innovations to the broader internal & external teams, community.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
  • Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
  • Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
  • Experience with end to end product delivery
  • Experience as a product manager or owner
  • Experience owning technology products

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
  • Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
