descriptionHtml:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.

What You’ll Be Part Of

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What You'll Be Responsible For

You will define and drive the long-term product strategy for the CPN Payments Engine — the foundational infrastructure that powers payment creation, routing, settlement, and lifecycle management across Circle’s global network.

You will operate as the end-to-end owner of payment execution across corridors and rails, shaping how the system evolves to support scale, resilience, and new financial use cases. This includes setting the vision for reliability, performance, and extensibility, and leading cross-functional efforts to translate that vision into measurable improvements in throughput, latency, and network success rates. You will also influence adjacent systems and partner integrations to ensure the Payments Engine operates as a cohesive, high-performing platform across the ecosystem.

Core Requirements

What you'll bring to Circle:

  • 8+ years of Product Management experience in payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure
  • Experience owning complex platform or infrastructure products such as payment engines, settlement systems, or distributed processing systems
  • Demonstrated ability to define and drive strategy for ambiguous, high-impact problem spaces with company-level implications
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to diagnose systemic issues in payment flows and drive data-informed decisions; proficiency with SQL or equivalent
  • Track record of delivering step-function improvements in system reliability, performance, or scalability
  • Experience influencing architecture and working deeply with Engineering on trade-offs and system design
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives across Engineering, Compliance, Operations, and external partners
  • Ability to operate seamlessly from strategic vision to hands-on execution, including writing detailed product and technical specifications
  • Clear and structured communicator, capable of aligning senior stakeholders and driving decision-making

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience with global payments networks, settlement systems, or financial infrastructure (e.g., cross-border payments, correspondent banking, stablecoins)
  • Deep understanding of two-sided network dynamics and marketplace liquidity challenges
  • Experience building compliance-forward systems where regulatory requirements shape product and system design
  • Expertise in API product management for enterprise or developer-facing platforms
  • Familiarity with payment lifecycle events, failure taxonomy, and large-scale operational tooling for monitoring and exception handling

This role is based in our Bangalore office and requires employees to work from the office on a regular basis.

Circle is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. We consider a wide variety of elements when crafting our compensation ranges and total compensation packages.

Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other protected status required by the laws in the locations where we hire. Additionally, Circle participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.

Should you require accommodations or assistance in our interview process because of a disability, please reach out to accommodations@circle.com for support. We respect your privacy and will connect with you separately from our interview process to accommodate your needs.

Job Title: Principal Product Manager

Location: India, Hybrid

This is a hybrid position, which will require the ability to be onsite in our Bengaluru, India office as needed. Candidates must be based in India.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Clari + Salesloft are building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

At Clari + Salesloft, our Principal Product Mgr will be pivotal to our company’s success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing team in India. We are looking for experienced Principal Product Mgr who can help realize Clari + Salesloft vision with their passion and proven track record of excellence and innovation. We are looking for Product Managers who are passionate about their work and who thrive working on leading-edge cloud-based technologies to develop ground-breaking AI-driven enterprise-grade applications.

On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible to -

  • Own the foundational integrations that power the platform
  • Engage with customers to understand their needs and translate them into compelling solutions
  • Identify new product opportunities and anticipate potential risks and blockers
  • Collaborate with leaders of other functions to refine product strategy and execute process improvements
  • Build alignment and drive decision-making across company-wide initiatives
  • Build impactful relationships and driving collaborative initiatives across functional teams, effectively influencing stakeholders at all levels
  • Contribute to technical trade-offs, design clean product interfaces and abstractions, and build systems to scale customer, competitor, and market understanding throughout the organization
  • Work closely with Engineering to drive an efficient R&D process, from leading scrums to coordinating product releases
  • Collaborate with Customer Success and Go-to-Market teams to ensure that we maximize the product's impact on both customers and our business

In addition to working with amazing colleagues who exemplify our ‘team over self’ core value, you will also have the opportunity to work on an impactful and revolutionary software that is changing the way sellers sell. You will have an opportunity to make a difference.

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Principal Product Mgr to join our dynamic Product Management team. This role will focus on the strategic development and enhancement of our Platform capabilities with the support of a local engineering team based in India. The ideal candidate will bring a blend of technical acumen, a deep understanding of product management principles, and a passion for delivering innovative solutions that drive customer value.

If you’re looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming a Principal Product Mgr is the career path for you!

Clari + Salesloft’ s goal is to build the world's first AI driven Predictive Revenue System.

  • Demonstrated expertise in platform development, with a portfolio of successful products

  • Outstanding presentation skills with the ability to communicate business and technical topics and adjust to diverse audiences

Description

Advertising is a strategic bet for Amazon and is one of the fastest growing business units within Amazon India. Sponsored Ads is our flagship performance ads product and the backbone of our Advertising business. We are strengthening our offering by continuously building and enhancing product capability to improve shopper engagement and advertiser experience.

We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager (Tech) to own monetization charter and grow Ads business in India and Emerging Markets.

You will work with a dedicated engineering and ML team and will heavily collaborate with stakeholders across WW, India and emerging countries. You will manage the complete business of your product area including establishing key metrics, setting and meeting goals on business/product metrics, advertiser engagement, and retention. You will be driving key metrics pertaining to advertisers, shoppers and Amazon.

Key job responsibilities

  • Identify product opportunities for the advertisement business using data, customer engagement studies and anecdotes. Create detailed near-term and longer-term roadmap for product.
  • Build product capabilities that help improve both advertiser experience (e.g. impressions, sales, ease of ad campaign management) and shopper engagement (e.g. CTR, relevance).
  • Build ads supply, formats, sourcing and ads relevance enhancements.
  • Use ML-techniques to build innovative solutions.
  • Play a key role in go-to-market of product features by influencing Marketing narrative and Sales / Account Management processes.
  • Manage all aspects of project including organizing and planning, estimating, managing resources, tracking, risk & opportunity, quality, documentation and change management.
  • Work closely with Tech and ML teams to create execution plans and ensure timely delivery of high-quality outputs.
  • Engage frequently with stakeholders (WW, India and Emerging markets) to identify collaboration opportunities

About The Team

You will be part of the IN Ads product team, reporting to the IN Ads product leader. You will have a dedicated Tech team (SDEs, TPM and SDM) for your Ad product and shared ML resources to help you innovate.

You will engage with other key teams in India Ads like Demand, Marketing, Sales and Account Management teams. Beyond these, you will have ample opportunities to interact and influence WW Product, Tech, Applied Science teams etc.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
  • Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
  • Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
  • Experience managing technical products or online services
  • Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
  • Experience with end to end product delivery

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
  • Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
  • Experience Experience in online advertising or high-tech products/services

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. descriptionHtml:
Company Background

Azuga, a Bridgestone company, is a leading global connected vehicle platform, helping customers turn data from vehicles and drivers into intelligence that improves operations and safety while reducing cost and risk. Azuga provides innovative end-to-end fleet solutions for commercial fleets, government agencies, insurance companies, and integrated software partners, through a comprehensive approach of hardware technology, fleet management applications, video telematics, and data analytics. All with a white glove customer experience.

Team Culture

We are a mission-driven team committed to remaining the fastest growing fleet management solution in the industry. We are a group of builders and doers — building the foundations of a results-oriented product team to deliver amazing experiences for our customers. We are a team with a strong commitment to customer-driven innovation, data-based decision making, and a bias for learning through experimentation.

Summary

Data is at the core of what Azuga does — every device in the field generates a continuous stream of signals that our customers depend on to run safer, smarter fleets. We are seeking a Senior Product Manager, Data, Analytics & AI to own the strategy and roadmap for how we collect, process, model, and surface that intelligence across the platform — and to help lead our emerging AI program from early initiative into a core platform capability.

This is a rare hybrid role. You will need to be equally comfortable in a technical conversation about data pipelines and model outputs as you are in a boardroom discussion about business outcomes and strategic direction. You will translate between two worlds — turning ambiguous business problems into clear technical requirements, and turning complex data and AI capabilities into intuitive, high-impact product experiences. You will work closely with engineering, data science, Sales, Customer Success, and executive leadership alike.

What You’ll Own

Data Ingestion & Pipeline Integrity

  • Own product requirements for how vehicle signals and driver events are collected, validated, and processed — from hardware in the field through to the data layer.
  • Define standards for data quality, completeness, and reliability in partnership with Engineering and Data Engineering, and ensure the infrastructure scales as fleet size and signal diversity grow.

Analytics & Insights Products

  • Own the roadmap for Azuga’s fleet analytics surfaces — dashboards, reports, trend analysis, and alert-driven insights — ensuring they are accurate, fast, and genuinely useful to fleet managers.
  • Define and evolve the metrics layer: what gets measured, how it’s calculated, and how it maps to customer outcomes like safety, efficiency, and cost reduction.

AI Program — Vision & Execution

  • Help lead Azuga’s AI program as it matures from a set of experiments into a standardized platform capability — owning the vision, roadmap, and delivery framework that makes AI a reliable, scalable part of the product.
  • Establish the infrastructure, data access patterns, and UX standards that allow AI features to be built and iterated consistently across the platform.
  • Define and track leading indicators of AI program health — such as recommendation acceptance rates and feature engagement — to measure real-world impact and guide investment decisions.
  • Serve as the product interface for data science and ML initiatives: framing problem statements, scoping features around model outputs, and ensuring AI-driven capabilities are explainable, trustworthy, and tied to measurable customer value.

Data APIs & Cross-Functional Translation

  • Define product requirements for external data APIs, ensuring Azuga’s data is accessible and reliable for partners and integrated software vendors.
  • Act as the connective tissue between technical and non-technical stakeholders — synthesizing inputs from Sales, Support, and executive leadership into a coherent product direction, and producing clear, detailed requirements that engineering teams can execute without ambiguity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and drive the data, analytics, and AI product roadmap, balancing near-term customer pain points against longer-term platform investment.
  • Lead product discovery across customer segments, translating feedback, usage data, and support escalations into prioritized requirements.
  • Write rigorous product requirements and user stories; partner with engineering and data science through the full development lifecycle.
  • Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and executive leadership — communicating clearly and managing expectations proactively.
  • Establish and monitor KPIs for data quality, analytics engagement, AI feature adoption, and API reliability.
  • Lead go-to-market planning and enablement for new analytics and AI feature launches.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with meaningful focus on data, analytics, or AI/ML products in B2B SaaS environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate between business requirements and technical specifications — comfortable in a data engineering standup and a Sales QBR in the same day.
  • Working fluency with data concepts: pipelines, schemas, APIs, event-driven architectures, and data quality frameworks. You don’t need to code, but you need to reason about tradeoffs at the technical level.
  • Experience working directly with data science or ML teams — defining problem statements, scoping features around model outputs, and making those outputs useful to end users.
  • High attention to detail — you write requirements that leave nothing ambiguous, and you catch the inconsistency others miss.
  • Excellent communicator with a track record of earning trust with engineers, data scientists, and executive stakeholders alike.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Business Analytics, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus.

Nice to Have

  • Background in fleet management, telematics, connected devices, or mobility/transportation.
  • Hands-on experience with BI platform product development (Looker, Tableau, or similar).
  • Familiarity with IoT data architectures, streaming pipelines, or AI-assisted prototyping workflows.

Join us at Azuga

This is a high-impact role at a company where data is the product and AI is the next frontier. You will own a domain that touches every fleet customer we serve and help shape how intelligence gets woven into everything Azuga does. If you find equal satisfaction in a cleanly defined schema and a well-told customer story — and thrive connecting those two things — we would love to hear from you.

Company Description

Moveworks is the Agentic AI Assistant platform that empowers the entire workforce.

Our platform enables employees to converse with all of their business systems through natural language to quickly find answers and automate tasks. Powered by the world's most advanced LLMs, our proprietary models, and a sophisticated Agentic AI platform, we're transforming how work gets done by allowing AI to take initiative, streamline complex workflows, and continuously learn and adapt.

Moveworks is trusted by over 5.5 million employees at more than 350 of the world’s largest companies, including 10% of the Fortune 500, to automate everyday tasks and streamline business operations. Recognized on the Forbes Cloud 100 and AI 50 lists, Moveworks was also named one of Fast Company’s 2025 Most Innovative Companies and Inc’s Best in Business, in the Best in Innovation category. Moveworks was also recognized at Microsoft’s 2025 Partner of the Year and in 2024, received the AI Breakthrough Award.

In December 2025, Moveworks was acquired by ServiceNow, marking a pivotal milestone in our journey to create a single front door to work for all business systems. By combining ServiceNow’s leading workflow automation with Moveworks’ Reasoning Engine and natural language capabilities, we deliver the AI platform for every person and every workflow. Built to go beyond basic summaries to deliver meaningful business impact. Together, our AI acts across enterprise systems to turn conversations into completed work.

By joining our team, you’ll be at the forefront of the AI transformation, backed by the global scale of ServiceNow and the agility of a high-growth company. We are looking for world-class talent to help us extend agentic AI to every employee across every corner of the business.

ServiceNow

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

Job Description

Moveworks is building the Agentic AI platform for all employees: a single interface for search &action across the entire enterprise.

Enterprise search is at the heart of employee productivity in the world as it enables them to quickly get the right information across multiple knowledge sources.

As a product manager for the enterprise search (Integrations) team, you’ll be on the bleeding edge of shaping the product strategy, technical implementation, and global rollout motion for the ES product.

  • You will drive product development for this product area from concept to launch with successful iteration in a fast-paced, customer-obsessed organization with an emphasis on written communication to convey product concepts and updates.
  • You will work with developers and other stakeholders of 3rd party software applications to understand the content hierarchy, APIs, and auth mechanisms.
  • You will create product specs to crisply identify problems, set goals, and define success metrics to help design and engineering teams develop products.
  • You will support cross-functional teams to achieve their goals through collaborative goal setting, project definition, and milestone development throughout the project.
  • You will ensure our designers deeply understand the problems to be solved and can test their ideas rapidly.
  • You will support our deployment teams in helping customers realize product value quickly.

Qualifications

One of the following should speak to you:

  • You are an experienced and accomplished Product Manager with 3+ years of experience and have successfully launched SaaS products.
  • You have experience in building integrations with large-scale systems developer toolkits.
  • You are an expert in deconstructing complex problems, annotating & understanding patterns, and taking a data-driven approach to finding solutions.
  • You are a strong writer who can consistently write clearly and concisely about new product concepts, operations, and plans.
  • You are someone deeply curious and a fast learner – eager to understand the technology behind new products, conduct your own academic & competitive research.
  • You have strong familiarity with APIs, authentication, and integrations.
  • You have experience building enterprise products that required 3rd party platform integrations.
  • You have a proven track record of taking ownership of product goals and delivering against them
  • You have a sound framework for when to iterate, when to discard, and when to scale products
  • You have the skills needed to take input from multiple sources, crystallize clear priorities, and communicate them effectively.
  • You are someone who can bridge the technical with the enterprise and cultivate challenging relationships with internal and external stakeholders with grace.
  • You are an effective communicator, you pay attention to the finer details, and you empathize with customers and stakeholders and build meaningful relationships.
  • You are curious and bring genuine excitement to learn new subject areas, and are comfortable being scrappy as and when needed.

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Noora Health India Private Limited is a key partner in Noora Health’s mission is to improve outcomes and strengthen health systems by equipping family caregivers with the skills they need to care for their loved ones. They develop content, technology platforms, new products, and strengthen other operational functions that support the scale and impact of Noora Health’s programs.

Founded in 2014, Noora Health turns hospital hallways and waiting rooms into classrooms by tapping into the most compassionate resources available for the patient’s care: their own family.

With support from governments and partners in India, Bangladesh, Indonesia, and Nepal, Noora Health has trained more than 58 million caregivers and patients across 16,300+ facilities using their flagship caregiver education and training curriculum, the Care Companion Program (CCP).

In a cohort of patients, the CCP reduced post-surgical cardiac complications by 71%, maternal complications by 12%, newborn complications by 16%, and newborn mortality by 18%.

Noora Health is an Audacious Project Grantee and received the Skoll Foundation Award for Social Innovation. To learn more, watch our TED Talk, Skoll feature, or read about our partnership with the World Health Organization.

About The Role

The Mobile Care Companion (MCC) is Noora Health's primary digital touchpoint for family caregivers post discharge, serving ~50,000 users a day across India, Bangladesh, Indonesia, and Nepal. It delivers behavior change and health system navigation at scale through two-way conversations, clinical triage, care coordination, and a growing set of AI-powered features.

This role owns MCC end-to-end: the caregiver experience, the health worker tools, the clinical workflows, and the AI layer that cuts across all of it. You will define what MCC becomes over the next three years, be accountable for both growth and outcomes, and lead an interdisciplinary team spanning product, clinical, data, and program functions to get there.

What You Will Do

  • Overall Model: Own the growth and operating model for MCC across user acquisition, activation, and retention at scale, including how MCC is positioned, priced, and deployed across government health systems and private partners
  • AI-led Product Experience: Reimagine the delivery with an AI-first thinking. Reason through where AI owns, where it assists, and where the experts jump in. Embed AI with an eval-led approach iterating to improve accuracy, engagement, and behavior change.
  • Product Roadmap: Set and execute the product roadmap to improve the user experience across the full funnel. Work with country program teams to translate local context (language, literacy, health system constraints) into product decisions that hold across four countries
  • Management & Execution: Deliver individually while also managing and mentoring a team of PMs, designers, clinicians across geographies.
  • Partnership & Advocacy: Represent the product with key internal and external stakeholders including health system partners, funders, leadership, and country teams to drive buy-in and unlock partnerships to drive MCC’s growth.

Who Are We Looking For

  • A 0-to-1 builder/founder: You have taken at least one product from concept to production to scale in a resource-constrained environment and owned its outcomes. You don't need scaffolding to get started
  • 6–12 years of product experience, with a meaningful share on AI-powered products; Hands-on fluency with LLMs: prompt design, retrieval architectures, eval pipelines, MCPs, and optimization workflows
  • Deeply data fluent and strong experimentation instinct: you obsesses about data, you define what good looks like before you build, and you are rigorous about measuring it
  • A first-principles thinker about complex service design. You are quick to build prototypes, sketch flows, write copies, and analyze and cut data to make your vision concrete
  • Able to work across clinical and technical teams, earn credibility with both, and translate between them clearly
  • Experience in healthcare, clinical tools, or other high-stakes domains is a strong plus

What We Value

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion, and we understand the value of developing a team with different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences. We prioritize diversity within our team, and we welcome candidates from all gender identities, castes, religious practices, sexual orientations, and abilities — among many others.

We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you'll fit right in.

The role:

We at Ads Product are all about making Ads more meaningful & relevant to our users and helping drive marketing objectives for our partners/advertisers. Ads is one of the ways Truecaller monetizes the app, and thus holds a critical role in driving Truecaller revenues. Truecaller is one of the largest standalone publishers in India and is growing quickly in international markets globally.

Responsible for - Driving revenue growth for Truecaller by building ads solutions and selling our ads offerings to our advertising partners globally.

We work at a planetary scale, serving billions of ad impressions daily. This is serious performance engineering! Truecaller has more than 500 million users globally, and our products need to run flawlessly on all of them.

We are looking for a Product Manager to own our Programmatic Ads Monetization stack end-to-end. This is a high-ownership, high-agency role at the heart of how Truecaller makes money - touching everything across the core ads platform from SDK on the device to the server-side in the back-end, supply strategy, and demand partnerships strategy.

What you'll do:

  • Own the Programmatic charter end-to-end
    • Drive the product roadmap for programmatic monetization for Truecaller
    • Define and execute the strategy for how our supply is structured, packaged, and exposed to programmatic demand
    • Work closely with Engineering to ship reliable, low-latency systems at billions-of-requests scale
  • Drive yield and revenue growth
    • Improve eCPMs, fill rates, and overall yield through smarter auction design, floor pricing, and supply-demand matching
    • Build meaningful segmentation across users, placements, and contexts to improve user relevance, ad request efficiency and overall yield
    • Identify and unlock new programmatic revenue streams
  • Own the Demand Partner strategy
    • Drive the product roadmap that manages a large portfolio of programmatic partners across oRTB, SDK, Open Bidding at massive scale
    • Build a healthier supply-demand equation - shape the right traffic to the right partners with the right signals
    • Continuously evaluate the partner mix and rationalize where needed
  • Experimentation and problem solving
    • Design and run experiments end-to-end with rigor on hypothesis, measurement, and rollout
    • Dive into ambiguous problems - auction dynamics, bid floor strategy, latency trade-offs, supply quality - and structure them into shippable bets
  • Cross-functional leadership
    • Work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Partnerships, Cross-functional PM teams to align on priorities and unblock execution
    • Communicate clearly with senior leadership on strategy, trade-offs, and outcomes
What you bring in:

  • 4 to 5 years of product management experience, with prior programmatic product experience strongly preferred (publisher side a plus)
  • Deep understanding of the programmatic ecosystem - Bidding, oRTB, header bidding, Open Bidding, SDK mediation, and the dynamics of modern auction design
  • Ad-tech fluency - comfortable in building under constraints of latency, caching, SDK behaviors, server-side architecture
  • Strong analytical chops - SQL proficiency and the ability to dig into data yourself rather than waiting for a dashboard
  • High bias for action, high ownership, and a "get things done" attitude in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment
  • Strategic thinking paired with willingness to roll up sleeves on the smallest details

What we offer:

We offer clear internal mobility and a transparent path for progression, with leaders who stay involved and provide guidance throughout the year. In addition, you will benefit from:

  • Modern tools to do your best work: Choose your preferred computer and phone within our budget, so you can work comfortably and efficiently.
  • A people-focused office culture: We value in-person collaboration and follow an office-first model, with some flexibility. Our offices offer a vibrant environment with opportunities to learn, connect, and recharge, from breakfast, lunch and quiet spaces to team activities such as movie nights, tech meetups, and cultural events. There's something for everyone.
  • Truecaller's "Lab Days" offer a space for imagination: 5 days each quarter, where everyone steps away from their normal tasks to explore new, bold ideas and build things they've always wanted to. It's a space where curiosity leads the way, and prototypes take shape. Some concepts even make it into production, and a few have grown into real features used by millions today. Lab Days allow you to be creative, learn fast, and help shape Truecaller's future.

Come as you are:

Truecaller is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe that a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences strengthens our products and our culture. No matter where you're from, what language you speak, or how you identify, we value what makes you unique and would love to get to know you.

Sounds like a great opportunity?

We will fill the position as soon as we find the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, we will conduct a background check.

We only accept applications in English.

Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

About The Role

Harness is seeking a Principal Product Manager to lead strategy and execution for the core Platform, Data Collection, and Integrations that power our API and AI Security portfolio. This role sits at the foundation of our security offerings, owning the systems that enable scalable data ingestion, observability, policy enforcement, and ecosystem connectivity across customer environments.

You will define and drive the long term platform vision, translating market shifts in API and AI security into durable architectural investments and differentiated capabilities. This includes instrumentation, telemetry pipelines, integration frameworks, data processing, and platform level services that enable protection at scale.

As a senior individual contributor, you will operate across product lines, partnering closely with Engineering, Customer Success, Sales Engineering, and Product Marketing to ensure we deliver enterprise grade solutions that are scalable, performant, and aligned with real world customer needs.

This role requires deep engagement with strategic customers, a strong understanding of security and infrastructure ecosystems, and the ability to turn complex technical challenges into clear product direction.

What You Will Do

Own Platform Strategy and Vision

  • Define and drive the long term strategy for core platform capabilities including data collection, telemetry, integrations, instrumentation, and shared services across API and AI security.
  • Align platform investments with the broader DevSecOps platform strategy and company goals.
  • Identify architectural priorities that unlock scale, performance, and enterprise readiness.

Drive Roadmap and Execution

  • Build and maintain a multi quarter roadmap that balances innovation, scalability, operational excellence, and customer outcomes.
  • Partner with Engineering to deliver high quality, reliable, and scalable platform capabilities.
  • Ensure iterative delivery with tight feedback loops from customers and field teams.
  • Define and track clear KPIs and success metrics to guide decision making.

Customer and Market Leadership

  • Engage directly with enterprise customers, including security, platform, and DevOps leaders, to understand deployment models, operational patterns, compliance requirements, and evolving AI driven use cases.
  • Identify patterns across customer needs and market trends, synthesize insights, and translate them into a clear product strategy.
  • Represent the platform vision internally and externally, articulating value, differentiation, and best practices.

Cross Functional Leadership

  • Act as the connective layer between field teams and engineering, ensuring clarity of priorities and strong alignment.
  • Work closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and Support to define success criteria for regulated, enterprise environments.
  • Communicate product direction and value clearly through structured documents and executive ready presentations.

Platform Quality And Experience

  • Champion scalable architecture, reliability, performance, and usability across platform capabilities.
  • Ensure integrations and data collection experiences are intuitive, secure, and enterprise ready.
  • Advocate for strong user experience across platform level workflows.

About You

  • 8 to 10 plus years of product management experience, with a strong track record owning and shipping infrastructure, platform, or security products at scale.
  • Deep experience in DevOps, cloud native systems, or security platforms, including telemetry, logging, data pipelines, or instrumentation.
  • Familiarity with technologies such as OpenTelemetry, observability systems, and large scale data processing architectures.
  • Direct experience building or managing API security, application security, or adjacent security products.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in fast moving, high growth environments and bring structure to ambiguity.
  • Strong analytical mindset with a data driven approach to decision making.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for executives, customers, and cross functional teams.
  • Proven ability to influence across functions without formal authority.
  • Clear history of building products used by developers, platform teams, or security engineering organizations.

Harness In The News

  • Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
  • Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
  • How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
  • Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
  • Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/

Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.

If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Harvey is building AI that transforms how the world's most sophisticated professionals work. We are looking for a Group Product Manager based in Bengaluru to drive the strategy, development, and delivery of Harvey's Knowledge Platform — the systems that connect Harvey to the legal world's content and tools. This means owning how we build and scale our ecosystem of third-party connectors and data partner integrations that bring rich legal context into Harvey, strengthening core user engagement. This is Harvey's first PM hire in India and a foundational role: you will own a critical product area end-to-end, work closely with our India Engineering team and cross-functional partners across time zones, and shape how Harvey builds and ships products. You will collaborate daily with Engineering, Design, Business Development, Legal Engineering, and GTM teams.

What You'll Do

  • Develop the product roadmap for Harvey's integrations and Knowledge Platform, defining vision, strategy, and priorities across document management systems, the legal tech connector ecosystem, and private legal data.
  • Partner closely with Harvey's India Engineering team to scope, design, and ship high-quality integrations and platform experiences at a rapid pace
  • Drive the strategy for expanding Harvey's connector ecosystem: integration aggregators and self-serve pathways that allow customers and partners to connect their own tools to Harvey at scale.
  • Work closely with business development to engage with partners and manage complex joint developments
  • Deeply understand the workflows of lawyers at leading law firms and in-house legal teams, translating that understanding into product decisions, especially around how enterprise knowledge (DMS files, matter data, firm content) flows into and shapes AI-powered workflows.
  • Act as a bridge between India and HQ (San Francisco / New York), ensuring tight communication loops and strategic alignment across sites.
  • Contribute to shaping Harvey's India product culture — setting the bar for how PMs operate in the region.

What You Have

  • 15+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years at a Staff or Senior PM level at a high-growth technology company.
  • Demonstrated ability to own and drive a product area end-to-end, from strategy through execution and iteration.
  • Strong technical fluency — you can have deep, substantive conversations with engineers about system design, data pipelines, API architecture, and infrastructure trade-offs, including topics like vector search, orchestration systems, and sync reliability.
  • Familiarity with enterprise SaaS go-to-market dynamics: customer commitments, partner integrations, access control and governance requirements, and the operational complexity of shipping to large law firms or regulated industries.
  • Track record of effective cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Design, GTM, and Customer Success — including navigating dependency-heavy roadmaps and partner relationships.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present to executives and external stakeholders with clarity and confidence.
  • Experience working in distributed or multi-site teams, with comfort operating across time zones.
  • Based in Bengaluru and eligible to work in India. Harvey does not currently offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in legal tech, professional services technology, or regulated industries.
  • Experience as a founding or early PM in a new-market or new-office setting.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, RAG architectures, or AI-native product design, and an intuition for how data quality and pipeline design affect AI output.

  • Familiarity with ORAN Standards , 3GPP standards. Knowledge of TMF API Standards Add on
  • Contribution to ORAN standard body Add on
  • Experience with operator environments — NOC, zero-touch operations, AIOps

  • Familiar with Python , Go , C & any public Cloud


Product & Agile

  • Ability to write crisp user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specs
  • Experience with roadmap tools (ProductBoard, or similar)
  • Strong RFP/RFI response experience — technical writing and solution architecture narratives


Good to Have

  • Experience with AI/ML-based anomaly detection in network monitoring contexts
  • Knowledge of GC log analysis, crash dump management, or binary log processing
  • Prior experience with operator deployments across regions (APAC, Europe, North America)


Soft Skills

  • Strong executive communication — able to present confidently to C-level stakeholders
  • Ability to work across time zones with distributed engineering and customer teams
  • Data-driven decision making — comfortable with metrics, dashboards, and usage analytics
  • Comfortable with ambiguity; able to define structure in fast-moving product environments


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Telecommunications, or Engineering
  • 10+ years total experience; 3+ years as PO/PM on a telecom software product
  • Certifications preferred: CSPO, SAFe PO/PM, TM Forum Framework

This role is ideal for someone who has operated at the intersection of telecom network operations and cloud-native software delivery — someone who speaks both 'operator NOC' and 'Kubernetes microservices' fluently.


RAKUTEN SHUGI PRINCIPLES:

Our worldwide practices describe specific behaviours that make Rakuten unique and united across the world. We expect Rakuten employees to model these 5 Shugi Principles of Success.

  • Always improve, always advance. Only be satisfied with complete success - Kaizen.
  • Be passionately professional. Take an uncompromising approach to your work and be determined to be the best.
  • Hypothesize - Practice - Validate - Shikumika. Use the Rakuten Cycle to success in unknown territory.
  • Maximize Customer Satisfaction. The greatest satisfaction for workers in a service industry is to see their customers smile.
  • Speed!! Speed!! Speed!! Always be conscious of time. Take charge, set clear goals, and engage your team.

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Vialto Partners is a market leader in Global Mobility Services. Our purpose is to “Connect the World.” We are unique and the only stand-alone global mobility business. This presents a rare opportunity for our clients, stakeholders and colleagues.

Our teams help companies streamline and effectively manage their global mobility programs in a cost-efficient and compliant manner. Our services focus on providing cross-border compliance and risk assessment for tax, immigration, business travel, rewards and compensation, and remote work.

Working at Vialto Partners is about getting the chance to be part of a global and dynamic team. Globally, Vialto Partners has over 8,000 staff worldwide and continues to grow. You will work with clients from a range of industries and different geographical locations. We believe in connecting the world and supporting our colleagues to do the same in their careers by undertaking assignments and opportunities globally that broaden their skills and ultimately benefit our clients.

Job Description

The Senior Product Manager – AI‑Driven Compensation & Payroll plays a pivotal role in shaping and scaling VialtoComp’s next generation of digital compensation and payroll experience. This role drives product strategy and delivery across AI‑enabled solutions that support complex, global compensation and payroll journeys for multinational clients and their mobile workforces. 

Operating at the intersection of global mobility, compensation, payroll, and applied AI, the role partners closely with engineering, data, design, tax, payroll, equity, and client service teams. The focus is on intelligently automating complexity, improving accuracy, reducing risk, and delivering predictive, insight‑driven experiences across highly regulated environments. 

This role contributes directly to the VialtoComp product suite, positioning AI‑enabled compensation and payroll products as market‑leading platforms that enhance decision‑making, improve compliance, and deliver meaningful efficiency gains for both clients and internal delivery teams. 

Key Responsibilities 

Product Delivery & Operational Ownership 

 

  • Take ownership of defined compensation and payroll product areas or capabilities, operating within an established product vision and strategy. 
  • Manage day‑to‑day product execution, ensuring backlog items are clearly defined, prioritised, and delivered to a high standard. 
  • Translate operational requirements from payroll, mobility, tax, and client service teams into actionable product features. 
  • Ensure delivered solutions meet compliance, auditability, and regulatory constraints across jurisdictions. 
  • Act as a key point of coordination between product, engineering, and operational delivery teams. 

 

AI & Automation Enablement 

 

  • Partner with engineering and data teams to embed AI‑enabled and rules‑based automation into payroll and compensation processes, such as:  
  • Payroll data validation and reconciliation 
  • Compensation calculations and reporting support 
  • Error detection, exception handling, and workflow orchestration 
  • Support the safe adoption of AI by helping define:  
  • Operational guardrails and approval workflows 
  • Explainability and transparency requirements 
  • Human‑in‑the‑loop processes where required   

Continuous Improvement & Product Operations 

 

  • Monitor product usage, operational metrics, defects, and feedback to drive continuous improvement. 
  • Help define and track operational success measures, such as processing efficiency, error reduction, and cycle‑time improvements. 
  • Support response to regulatory change by coordinating product updates with SMEs and delivery teams. 
  • Contribute to improving product delivery practices, documentation, and ways of working within the product organization. 

 

Qualifications / Experience 

 

  • 4–6 years of experience in product management, business analysis, or product‑led delivery roles. 
  • Experience working on operational, regulated, or data‑intensive platforms, ideally in payroll, compensation, tax, finance, or HR technology. 
  • Strong ability to convert operational and regulatory requirements into clearly scoped product work. 
  • Experience working with automation and AI‑enabled tools, particularly where accuracy, auditability, and compliance are critical. 
  • Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills across technical and non‑technical teams. 
  • Comfortable working within an existing product strategy while improving delivery effectiveness and product quality. 

Vialto is unstoppable when we work together in a culture of belonging, where everyone can thrive. We encourage employees to bring their true selves and share their unique talents and expertise to positively impact the communities we serve. To learn more about what we do, tune in to our podcast On the Move to hear expert insights on issues affecting global mobility, and read about the latest news in the industry. You can also follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Project Role: Product Owner/ Business Analyst

Work Experience: 2-10 Years

Work location: Chennai OR Bangalore

Work Mode: Hybrid

Must Have Skills: EMR/EHR in Hospital domain


Job Overview

A Hospital Information System (HIS) Product Owner is responsible for defining, prioritizing, and managing the product backlog for assigned modules within the HIS, ensuring the product meets business needs and delivers value to users. This role involves close collaboration with stakeholders across various teams including product engineering, QA and Client service teams as well as Client users to translate business requirements into actionable user stories and acceptance criteria. They also play a crucial role in analyzing the product backlog and roadmap, guiding the development process from concept to launch


Key Responsibilities

  • Product Vision and Strategy
  • Understanding product vision, goals, and strategy for the HIS, ensuring alignment with business objectives and user need
  • Requirements Gathering and Management
  • Working with stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document requirements, translating them into detailed user stories and acceptance criteria
  • Backlog Management
  • Prioritizing and managing the product backlog, ensuring that features and enhancements are aligned with the product vision and roadmap
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Collaborating with various stakeholders, including clinicians, administrators, and IT teams, to gather feedback, manage expectations, and ensure alignment
  • Agile Development
  • Participating in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and other Agile ceremonies to guide development efforts and ensure timely delivery.
  • Quality Assurance
  • Collaborating with the QA team to ensure the delivered product meets quality standards and user expectations.
  • Market Research
  • Staying informed about industry trends, competitor offerings, and emerging technologies to identify opportunities for innovation and improvement.


User Experience:

  • Working with UX/UI designers to ensure the HIS is user-friendly and provides a positive user experience
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Ensuring the HIS complies with relevant healthcare regulations and standards
  • Performance Monitoring
  • Tracking key product metrics to assess performance and identify areas for improvement
  • Training and Support
  • Working with training teams to develop and deliver training materials for users


Skills and Experience

  • Healthcare Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of the healthcare industry, including workflows, regulations, and technology
  • Product Management Experience: Proven experience in product management, preferably with HIS or other healthcare IT system
  • Agile Methodology: Familiarity with Agile development methodologies, such as Scrum or Kanban.
  • Communication and Collaboration: Excellent communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills.
  • Problem-Solving: Ability to identify and resolve complex problems.
  • Technical Proficiency: Understanding of software development principles and technologies.
  • Leadership and Influence: Ability to lead and motivate cross-functional teams.
  • Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions

Description

Responsibilities:

Marketplace Strategy & Partnership Development:

  • Map the AI data landscape: Develop a comprehensive view of what data types frontier model builders need most and where market gaps exist that we can uniquely fill.
  • Integrate our existing capabilities: Orchestrate synthetic data pipelines, expert-curated data from GenAI business line, generalist annotations from search/ads workflows, and physical-world data from automotive pipelines into a unified marketplace offering.
  • Unlock new data sources: Forge partnerships to access premium content behind paywalls and enterprise datasets that haven't been available to AI builders.
  • Onboard external data producers: Identify organisations generating valuable datasets that model builders need but lack the infrastructure to monetise on their own.
  • Structure win-win deals: Design partnership models and monetisation frameworks that work for data producers, AI companies, and our platform.
  • Build the technical integration: Define how diverse data sources connect to our marketplace infrastructure while maintaining quality standards and provenance tracking.
  • Execute the vision: Transform fragmented data capabilities into a coherent marketplace that establishes TELUS Digital AI as the central hub where AI builders source training data.

Product Strategy & Roadmap Definition:

  • Define the product vision, strategy, and phased roadmap for the AI Data Marketplace-including data discovery, licensing models, quality verification, and integration capabilities.
  • Prioritise features ruthlessly based on marketplace impact: enabling seamless data discovery, streamlining partnership onboarding, building trust through provenance tracking, and creating transparent monetisation mechanisms.
  • Develop clear, actionable product requirements, user stories, and specifications that effectively bridge operational needs with technical solutions.

Execution & Cross-Functional Leadership:

  • Drive the product development lifecycle from ideation through requirements, design oversight, launch, and iteration.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Business Development, Legal, Finance, and existing product lines to ensure marketplace velocity and strategic alignment.
  • Champion a data-driven approach, using marketplace metrics (supply/demand balance, deal velocity, data quality signals) to continuously refine product strategy and partnership models

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience (8-10 years) in Product Management, with a clear track record of launching and iterating on complex systems, operational tools, or data platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to deeply understand complex operational workflows first-hand and translate those insights into impactful product requirements.
  • Prior experience in B2B, partnerships, or growth product management.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; highly proficient in using data (quantitative and qualitative) to diagnose problems and guide decisions.
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills – capable of building strong relationships and driving alignment across diverse teams (ops, technical, business).
  • Experience defining product vision, strategy, and roadmaps, particularly in ambiguous or rapidly evolving environments.

Preferred / Bonus:

  • Experience in domains directly related to data operations, data annotation platforms, data quality systems, AI/ML infrastructure, or managing specialised expert talent networks.
  • Past entrepreneurial experience, or as a software/ML engineer or designer
  • Experience working on multi-sided marketplaces
  • Experience with products designed for technical, scientific, or highly skilled knowledge workers.
  • You have multiple side projects/initiatives and the work to show for it

descriptionHtml:
Role: Product Management

Level: RL4

Location: Bangalore

Reporting to: Director - Product Management

About The Function

Ground Transport is one of the fastest growing businesses at MakeMyTrip, serving millions of travellers across Bus, Rail and Cab journeys. The business plays a critical role in expanding travel accessibility across India, particularly in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities, while delivering seamless, affordable and reliable mobility experiences.

As travel behaviours evolve, Ground Transport is reimagining the booking and travel experience enabled with AI-first product innovation. From personalized recommendations to conversational booking journeys, automated customer assistance and real-time decision systems, we are building the next generation of travel experiences at scale.

The Ground Transport team combines deep consumer understanding, data-driven decision making and cutting-edge technology to solve complex traveller problems across the entire journey lifecycle. Product managers, business leaders, engineers, designers and data scientists work together to build experiences that delight customers and drive meaningful business outcomes.

About The Role

We are looking for a Product Manager to define and scale the next generation of consumer experiences across Ground Transport. This role requires strong product thinking, execution excellence and a passion for solving customer problems through technology, data and AI.

You will own the product vision, roadmap and execution for key Ground Transport experiences, working closely with cross-functional teams to build products that improve customer engagement, conversion, retention and overall traveller satisfaction.

You Will Operate At The Intersection Of

  • Consumer Product + Growth + Data Science + AI-powered Experiences
  • 0-to-1 Innovation and 1-to-N Scaling
  • Customer Understanding + Data-Driven Decision Making
  • You will identify high-impact opportunities, rapidly validate solutions, and scale products that create measurable value for both customers and the business.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Define and execute the product vision, strategy and roadmap for key Ground Transport customer experiences.
  • Identify high-impact customer and business problems across discovery, booking and traveller engagement journeys, and translate them into scalable product opportunities.
  • Build AI-powered and data-driven experiences that improve trip planning, booking confidence and personalization.
  • Drive rapid experimentation, prototyping and validation of new concepts before scaling them into production-ready products.
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Business, Analytics and Data Science teams to build accurate, scalable and impactful solutions.
  • Define clear hypotheses, success metrics and measurement frameworks for product initiatives.
  • Own product KPIs and continuously improve performance through experimentation, customer feedback and data analysis.
  • Leverage customer insights, behavioural data and market intelligence to shape product strategy and prioritization.
  • Balance short-term business goals with long-term platform and product investments.
  • Lead end-to-end execution from concept to launch and post-launch optimization.

Required

 What You Are Required to Bring to the Team

  • A passion for solving complex customer problems through technology, data and innovation.
  • Strong product thinking with the ability to translate ambiguous business challenges into structured product solutions.
  • Deep curiosity about emerging ML and GenAI capabilities and their application in creating superior customer experiences.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to work with large datasets and make data-driven decisions.
  • Good understanding of technology systems and how technical decisions influence product outcomes and scalability.
  • Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across business, engineering, design, analytics and leadership teams.
  • High ownership mindset with the ability to independently drive initiatives from ideation to execution.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Engineering & Management graduates from reputed institutes with 3 to 4 years of experience in product management roles for consumer-facing, technology-enabled businesses.
  • Experience managing the complete product lifecycle using agile methodologies including requirement definition, prioritization, user experience design and metric tracking.
  • Experience working with complex datasets using analytical tools and techniques. Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and SQL is expected.
  • Prior experience with product analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Amplitude or Mixpanel will be an added advantage.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in travel, mobility, e-commerce or marketplace businesses.
  • Exposure to ML or GenAI-powered customer experiences.
  • Experience with personalization, recommendation systems or conversational interfaces.
  • Experience working with large-scale consumer products serving millions of users.

Toast is building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: running the businesses they love. We've grown into a leading hospitality software company in the U.S., and are now entering our next phase of growth—one defined by scale, complexity, and a new class of enterprise customers.

Every restaurant is unique, and a restaurant's menu expresses its individual brand and product offerings. Inside a Toast restaurant, the definition of the menu becomes the common language between guests, servers, and the kitchen. In our digital ordering products, a great menu serves as both a billboard and a roadmap to an excellent dining experience. It is the central hub for restaurant configuration—it determines what guests can order, how the dishes are presented and priced in different contexts, where they are routed for fulfillment, how they are prepared, whether the ingredients are still available, and how they are classified for reporting.

A menu is always evolving: kitchens create new dishes, managers experiment with pricing and presentation, and staff optimize the menu for restaurant operations. As our customers grow—from single-location cafés to enterprise brands with thousands of locations—so does the complexity of managing these changes consistently, confidently, and at scale.

The Menus team is building for this future. We own the user experiences and APIs that all Toast customers use to manage their menus, the APIs consumed by first- and third-party integrations (like DoorDash and UberEats), and the underlying menu data models that support the full spectrum of restaurant verticals—from Pizzerias to Fine Dining to Retail. We are working to make menus truly enterprise-grade: allowing customers to efficiently audit and manage changes across thousands of locations, while innovating on conversational menu management experiences powered by the Toast IQ platform.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to drive the vision, strategy, and execution of the customer-facing menu management experience. You'll work closely with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to craft an experience that helps customers manage their menus with confidence—whether they're rolling out a seasonal menu, updating prices across hundreds of locations, or restructuring their menu to improve kitchen throughput. You'll collaborate closely with a partner menus team based in the US to ensure a coherent and unified product strategy across the menus domain.

About this roll* (Responsibilities)

  • Own and evolve the product strategy for Toast's menu management experience, with a focus on:
  • Designing workflows that help customers manage menu changes over time—pricing updates, seasonal rotations, item availability, and structural changes that improve kitchen speed and operational efficiency
  • Building experiences that work for the full spectrum of Toast customers: from owner-operators managing a single location to enterprise teams managing menus across thousands
  • Exploring and integrating automation and AI-assisted ('agentic') workflows into menu configuration and publishing experiences, in partnership with the Toast IQ platform
  • Ensuring coherence across the menus product surface area, in close collaboration with the US-based menus PM and leadership
  • Build and maintain a roadmap in alignment with business OKRs, customer needs, and technical feasibility
  • Drive feature development from ideation through launch—writing clear specs, collaborating with engineering and design, and measuring success
  • In partnership with engineering and design counterparts, contribute to a development team by providing clear direction, setting priorities, and fostering a culture of customer-centricity, innovation, and accountability

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements)

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of product management experience, preferably with platform or POS products
  • Strong track record of delivering user-facing features in fast-paced environments
  • Analytical rigor—you use data to make decisions and validate assumptions
  • Empathy for restaurants and a passion for improving their day-to-day
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to influence without authority
  • Experience working cross-functionally and collaborating effectively across time zones

How Toast Uses AI In Its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. The restaurant industry is one of the most diverse, and we embrace that diversity with authenticity, inclusivity, respect, and humility. descriptionHtml:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

About The Role

Harness is seeking a Principal Product Manager to lead strategy and execution for the core Platform, Data Collection, and Integrations that power our API and AI Security portfolio. This role sits at the foundation of our security offerings, owning the systems that enable scalable data ingestion, observability, policy enforcement, and ecosystem connectivity across customer environments.

You will define and drive the long term platform vision, translating market shifts in API and AI security into durable architectural investments and differentiated capabilities. This includes instrumentation, telemetry pipelines, integration frameworks, data processing, and platform level services that enable protection at scale.

As a senior individual contributor, you will operate across product lines, partnering closely with Engineering, Customer Success, Sales Engineering, and Product Marketing to ensure we deliver enterprise grade solutions that are scalable, performant, and aligned with real world customer needs.

This role requires deep engagement with strategic customers, a strong understanding of security and infrastructure ecosystems, and the ability to turn complex technical challenges into clear product direction.

What You Will Do

Own Platform Strategy and Vision

  • Define and drive the long term strategy for core platform capabilities including data collection, telemetry, integrations, instrumentation, and shared services across API and AI security.
  • Align platform investments with the broader DevSecOps platform strategy and company goals.
  • Identify architectural priorities that unlock scale, performance, and enterprise readiness.

Drive Roadmap and Execution

  • Build and maintain a multi quarter roadmap that balances innovation, scalability, operational excellence, and customer outcomes.
  • Partner with Engineering to deliver high quality, reliable, and scalable platform capabilities.
  • Ensure iterative delivery with tight feedback loops from customers and field teams.
  • Define and track clear KPIs and success metrics to guide decision making.

Customer and Market Leadership

  • Engage directly with enterprise customers, including security, platform, and DevOps leaders, to understand deployment models, operational patterns, compliance requirements, and evolving AI driven use cases.
  • Identify patterns across customer needs and market trends, synthesize insights, and translate them into a clear product strategy.
  • Represent the platform vision internally and externally, articulating value, differentiation, and best practices.

Cross Functional Leadership

  • Act as the connective layer between field teams and engineering, ensuring clarity of priorities and strong alignment.
  • Work closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and Support to define success criteria for regulated, enterprise environments.
  • Communicate product direction and value clearly through structured documents and executive ready presentations.

Platform Quality And Experience

  • Champion scalable architecture, reliability, performance, and usability across platform capabilities.
  • Ensure integrations and data collection experiences are intuitive, secure, and enterprise ready.
  • Advocate for strong user experience across platform level workflows.

About You

  • 8 to 10 plus years of product management experience, with a strong track record owning and shipping infrastructure, platform, or security products at scale.

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.

If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.
